purpose: Authoritative terrain base for a historically grounded Castalla game scene.

coordinateSystem.originPolicy: Shared world origin for all future Castalla assets.

geographicReference.note: Geographic values are reference metadata. The GLB itself uses local game coordinates.

preservationRules: Do not alter the overall hill proportions.
Keep this terrain as a separate asset.

terrain_highest_vertex.usage: Diagnostic reference only; not automatically the castle origin.

summit_reference_centroid.usage: Provisional spatial reference for future castle registration.

castle1244.placementPolicy: The future castle GLB must share this world coordinate system. Preferred workflow: export the castle already registered to this terrain so both terrain and castle load at position [0,0,0], rotation [0,0,0], scale [1,1,1].
doNot: Do not let AI invent castle placement.
Do not infer final castle rotation only from visual appearance.
Do not modify terrain to force-fit the castle.

village1244.placementPolicy: Use the same world origin and meter scale as terrain and castle.

cinevvaImportRules: Keep position, rotation and scale unchanged.
Do not generate a castle or village yet.
Treat world.json as authoritative scene metadata.
When future registered GLBs are supplied, preserve their transforms exactly.
fidelityWarning: This terrain is a game-reference reconstruction, not a survey-grade LiDAR/DEM model. Replace/refine with official high-resolution terrain data later if exact topographic fidelity is required.
